name: Brookdale Farm & Market
tagline: Brookdale Farm & Market Chesapeake on the Land Conservation Assistance Network
description: Brookdale Farm & Market is a working pumpkin patch in Vaughan Road, VA. It grows Strawberries, Peaches, Pumpkins, Squash, and Corn, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
